svg.text: Phase 4 — the rules, the output, the evidence tools, the checks
Task groups 4.1 to 4.5, inside ADA_ECU/. Fourteen subtasks, no platform and no person needed by any of them.
the scene: ego, B, and ghost C
the first risk rule — one file
one event per real change
the warning message, built
the sender to the display node
assess and send, on the tick
the optional steady stream
the stand-in receiver
the readable event list
both vehicles, asserted
the six timing checks
traffic recording, in the node
turning the log back into a file
the loopback lane: warning out,
and none when C stays away
The risk rule is the phase's own proof of a claim the previous phase made: adding a
second kind of hazard is one new file and one added line, with nothing else touched.
That is visible in the commit itself, which is why the plan makes the shape of the diff
part of the acceptance rather than a matter of style.
closed; two CI runs carry the evidence
blocked on Phase 1 and Phase 3 landings
optional, deliberately skipped
